# A sngl:seq sequence compiles to a loop and never to a list. Written directly
# in a loop head it is the host's counting loop; held in a variable or passed
# to a function it is the pull sequence iter<int> is, which the consumer
# drives one value at a time -- a range func in Go, a generator in JS, an
# IntProgression in Kotlin. Nothing here builds a slice to walk it, which is
# the whole reason the package exists.

sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --out=go app.sngl
exists go/model.go

# The loop head counts. The end bound is bound once in the init clause,
# because SNGL evaluates the iterable once and the condition reads it per
# iteration.
grep 'for i, __end := 1, ' go/model.go
grep 'i < __end; i\+\+' go/model.go

# A descending step counts down, and the end bound stays exclusive.
grep 'for d, __end := .*; d > __end; d -= 2' go/model.go

# The held sequence is a func the loop pulls from, and iter<int> is spelled as
# that func -- no slice anywhere.
grep 'held := func\(__a, __b, __s int\) func\(func\(int\) bool\)' go/model.go
grep 'for h := range held' go/model.go
grep 'func Total\(xs func\(func\(int\) bool\)\) int' go/model.go
! grep 'held := \[\]int'

# A list reaching an iter<int> parameter is wrapped in a yielding func rather
# than copied into one: the wrapper walks the caller's own slice.
grep 'Total\(func\(__yield func\(int\) bool\) \{' go/model.go
grep 'for _, __v := range ys \{' go/model.go

sngl generate --platform=html --lang=none --out=web app.sngl
grep 'for \(let i = 1, __end = ' web/index.html
grep 'for \(let d = ' web/index.html
# Held: a generator, driven by for...of.
grep 'function\* \(__a, __b, __s\)' web/index.html
grep 'yield __i' web/index.html
! grep '__out.push(__i)'

sngl generate --platform=android --lang=kotlin --out=droid app.sngl
grep 'for \(i in 1 until ' droid/MainScreen.kt
grep 'for \(d in \(.* downTo 0 \+ 1\) step 2\)' droid/MainScreen.kt
# Held: an IntProgression, and the parameter that takes one is an Iterable.
grep 'fun total\(xs: Iterable<Int>\)' droid/MainScreen.kt
! grep '.toList()'

-- app.sngl --
import "sngl:seq"
import . "sngl:ui"

func total(xs iter<int>) int {
    var sum = 0
    for var x = xs {
        sum = sum + x
    }
    return sum
}

component main {
    var n = 6
    var total2 = 0

    button(text="sum", @click {
        for var i = seq.range(1, n) {
            total2 = total2 + i
        }
        for var d = seq.step(n, 0, -2) {
            total2 = total2 + d
        }
        var held iter<int> = seq.count(n)
        for var h = held {
            total2 = total2 + h
        }
        var ys list<int> = [1, 2, 3]
        total2 = total2 + total(ys)
    })
    text(value=string(total2))
}
